title: format_message_line silently drops messages missing receivedAt with no comment
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:271: receivedAt is the only field whose absence causes format_message_line to return None (via ?). Missing senderId and body both have fallbacks. A message with no body renders as 'HH:MM sender: '; a message with no receivedAt is silently dropped. This asymmetry is not apparent to a maintainer. A one-line comment at the ? operator would prevent confusion: // required; absence silently drops the message from display.
